candidate.content: For cool-then-place tasks targeting leafy vegetables (e.g., lettuce), prioritizing inspection of open horizontal surfaces (countertops) before closed storage receptacles can rapidly locate and acquire the target. In this instance, navigating to countertop_1 then countertop_2 resulted in finding lettuce_1 on the second surface visited, requiring only 3 actions total for acquisition.
candidate.scope: ALFWorld pick_cool_then_place_in_recep tasks where the target is a food item likely staged for preparation (leafy greens/vegetables) and the environment contains multiple accessible countertops.

direct_grounding.semantic_fact: The agent navigated to countertop_1 and observed various items (bowls, credit cards, sponge, bottle) but no lettuce.
The agent navigated to countertop_2 and observed lettuce_1 and lettuce_2 among other items (bread, cups, knives).
The agent successfully took lettuce_1 from countertop_2, completing the acquisition phase.

minimal_global_context: The task instruction was 'put a cool lettuce in countertop', implying the need to first find and take a lettuce object.
